notes.title: 4th update to Flag Builder Studio
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280999/9a435c003d8a6312ced71e5e94044971856707e2.jpg[/img]
The fourth update of FBS is randomized flags. Not only that, the button generates a random country name too!

Individual shapes now are just shapes, without the background. Probably that was the way they had to be from the start. Couple of templates are gone, because flags with a triangle at hoist (like Czechia) can now be made with layers.

You can join the Discord to discuss FBS: https://discord.gg/StwnxP6

notes.title: 3rd update to Flag Builder Studio
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280999/c8e30bfb181da8e2adb4e1f53dc7b62b354536e4.jpg[/img]
The third update of FBS is an ability to upload your own SVG charges. Careful, there might be bugs - vector graphics are fickle. It's recommended to have one shape, without overlays. Border width doesn't count (if you want contour, transform lines to objects).

There are some premade shapes too, like 50 stars of USA or Canadian maple leaf.

Added layers now has option of transparency.

You can join the Discord to discuss FBS: https://discord.gg/StwnxP6

notes.title: 2nd update to Flag Builder Studio
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280999/40d5df5a2fb351805c4b7f356753c625ae9cf8f8.jpg[/img]

In the second update we get the ability to add layers to the flags. The stack of layers is displayed at the left edge of the screen.

Every layer has the same interface as the base layer, and also scale (in percents) and position inputs. Layer can be placed in three positions along each axis. The default position is the left top corner, as a canton.

You can join the Discord to discuss FBS: https://discord.gg/StwnxP6

notes.title: 1st update to Flag Builder Studio
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280999/3f2d0076bb9af9dece5274e8ab75df7a65177da3.jpg[/img]
First update to Flag Builder Studio is what I call "the stripes update". Maybe it's not a huge one, but essential for sure.

Why would someone limit themselves to merely three stripes on a flag? Now there's a procedural workflow to create stripes! Pick one of six different types of stripy flags, distinguished by amount and direction of stripes, and enter a number in the field to the left of the flag.

Layer workflow should be coming in the next update.

You can join the Discord to discuss FBS: https://discord.gg/StwnxP6
